documents_expected.why: programme grants page with the Public Support Grants summary
the Request for Proposals: activities, recipients, required annexes, criteria, timeline

eligibility.rule: NGOs registered in the Philippines in conservation, development or related fields
eligibility.quote: NGOs refer to non-government organizations duly registered under Philippines laws;

eligibility.rule: Recognised community, people's, indigenous peoples' or women's rights organisations
eligibility.quote: Organized and recognized community-based organizations, people's organizations (POs), indigenous peoples' organizations (IPOs), and/or women's rights organizations (WROs) who work in the environment and/or development field;

eligibility.rule: Work in the Philippines, with priority for the PCP4NbS areas
eligibility.quote: Priority shall be given to eligible projects and entities within the PCP4NbS priority areas and project sites.

eligibility.rule: Support existing nature-based solutions (at least one of the mandatory criteria)
eligibility.quote: The proposal must also demonstrate support for NbS initiatives by responding to one or more of the following criteria (mandatory):

eligibility.rule: PhP 1–2 million over up to 8 months from February 2027
eligibility.quote: Public Support Grants may be between PhP 1,000,000 to PhP 2,000,000, with an implementation period of up to 8 months starting in February 2027 onwards.

documents.quote: Requirements for Project Proposals Full Proposal
Annex A. Work and Budget Plan
Annex B: Project Monitoring and Evaluation Framework

effort.step: Register one account on the Grants Portal
effort.quote: Only one account is allowed per individual or organization.
Deadline for Technical Questions October 31, 2026, 5:00 pm (PHT)

effort.step: Upload the proposal and annexes on the Grants Portal
effort.quote: Deadline of Submission of Proposals November 23, 2026, 5:00 pm (PHT)

effort.step: If approved, sign a Special Fund Agreement
effort.quote: Once a proposal is approved, the Foundation will enter into a legally-binding Special Fund Agreement with the grantee.

consortium_required.quote: Implementation may be through integrated projects by one organization, or several organizations in a consortium

notes: The RFP sits on www.forestfoundation.ph, linked from the programme page; the gather didn't rank it among its documents. Proposals over PhP 500,000 go to the Program Committee and Board. Late proposals may be considered if funds remain. Reporting duties are in the Special Fund Agreement, which isn't published.
